capabilities: Insert strictly RTL text inside math expressions using \R{\text{...}}
Nest strictly LTR text inside RTL using \L{...}
Nest math inside RTL/LTR text using $...$ or \(...\)
Configure the names of the \R and \L commands in settings
extras: README warns that languages with combining letters such as Arabic are not supported, pending MathJax 4.0 (mathjax/MathJax#3041).
problem: Obsidian's math rendering offers no built-in way to write RTL text (e.g. Hebrew) inside math expressions, and nesting LTR or math inside it breaks directionality.

relations.evidence: mixing right-to-left (RTL) and left-to-right (LTR) text in MathJax expressions

summary: Adds configurable LaTeX commands to mix right-to-left and left-to-right text inside Obsidian's MathJax math expressions.
